in_hebrew.name: Nicky
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Victory of the people
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Nicky הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Nikos, meaning 'victory'. In Christianity, this name is associated with St. Nicholas, a bishop renowned for his generosity and miracles. Nicky can symbolize the victory of good over evil.

in_greek.name: Nicky
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Victory of the people
in_greek.long_meaning: Nicky είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name Nikos, meaning 'victory'. In Christianity, this name is associated with St. Nicholas, a bishop renowned for his generosity and miracles. Nicky can symbolize the victory of good over evil.

in_latin.name: Nicky
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Victory of the people
in_latin.long_meaning: Nicky est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Nikos, meaning 'victory'. In Christianity, this name is associated with St. Nicholas, a bishop renowned for his generosity and miracles. Nicky can symbolize the victory of good over evil.
